title: WISE: A Long-Horizon Agent in Minecraft with Why-Which Reasoning
title_zh: WISE：具备 Why-Which 推理能力的 Minecraft 长时程智能体
abstract_en: Rapid advances have been made in developing general-purpose embodied agent in environments like Minecraft through the adoption of LLM-augmented hierarchical approaches. Despite their promise, low-level controllers often become performance bottlenecks due to repeated execution failures. We argue that a key limitation is not only the lack of episodic memory, but also the decoupling of \textit{what-where-when} memory from \textit{which-why} reasoning. To address this, we propose \textbf{WISE} (Which-Why Informed Semantic Explorer), a long-horizon agent framework with an enhanced low-level controller equipped with a Causal Event Graph that augments episodic memory with explicit causal structure linking observations to task relevance. Unlike prior work such as MrSteve, which relies on feature similarity for retrieval, WISE enables robust recall under viewpoint changes and supports opportunistic task reordering through causal reasoning. Building on this memory, we propose an Opportunistic Task Scheduler that dynamically re-prioritizes subtasks when causally relevant opportunities are detected. We further equip WISE with a multi-scale progressive exploration strategy to provide spatially comprehensive observations for downstream reasoning. Experiments show that WISE largely improves task success and efficiency on long-horizon sparse tasks, particularly in settings requiring adaptive decision-making.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 WISE（Which-Why Informed Semantic Explorer），一个面向 Minecraft 长时程稀疏任务的具身智能体框架。作者指出，现有 LLM 增强的分层智能体虽然在通用任务中进展明显，但低层控制器常因重复执行失败成为瓶颈；问题不仅在于缺乏情节记忆（episodic memory），还在于 what-where-when 记忆与 which-why 因果推理之间相互割裂。WISE 在低层控制器中引入 Causal Event Graph，将观察与任务相关性用显式因果结构连接起来，从而增强记忆检索与任务决策。相比依赖特征相似度检索的 MrSteve，WISE 能在视角变化下更稳健地回忆关键信息，并通过因果推理支持机会式任务重排序。此外，WISE 设计了 Opportunistic Task Scheduler，在检测到与当前或未来子任务因果相关的机会时动态调整优先级；同时采用多尺度渐进探索策略，为后续推理提供更全面的空间观察。实验表明，WISE 在长时程稀疏任务上显著提升成功率与效率，尤其适用于需要自适应决策的场景。
key_points_zh: 提出 WISE，一个结合 Causal Event Graph、机会式调度与多尺度探索的 Minecraft 长时程智能体框架。
核心改进是将 what-where-when 情节记忆与 which-why 因果推理结合，显式建模观察事件与任务相关性的因果联系。
相比 MrSteve 等基于特征相似度的记忆检索方法，WISE 在视角变化下更鲁棒，并能利用因果线索进行机会式任务重排序。
Opportunistic Task Scheduler 可在发现与子任务因果相关的环境机会时动态调整任务优先级，提高稀疏长程任务效率。
实验显示 WISE 在长时程稀疏任务中显著提升任务成功率和执行效率，尤其适合需要自适应决策的场景。

llm_assessment.comment: WISE improves embodied-agent memory and scheduling in Minecraft, but it appears more like architectural enhancement than a persistent learning-from-traces loop.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: WISE改进了Minecraft具身智能体的记忆与调度，但更像架构增强，而非持久的轨迹学习闭环。
